birmingham_boutique_keeper.text: Alright, bab? Brum has more canals than Venice and more coat racks than anywhere. Have a wander.

then.text: The {worn_hat} looks right on you. Mind how you go through the Bullring.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: Nothing special on, is there? Well, let's give you a story.

birmingham_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
